description: A React component implementing a virtualized threaded message viewer with scrolling, timestamp, and reply features for Mattermost.

classes.name: ThreadViewerVirtualized
classes.description: A React PureComponent that renders a virtualized list of threaded posts with scrolling, timestamp, and reply functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes component state and measures RHS when mounted.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up when component is unmounted.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to props, such as scrolling to highlighted or new posts.

methods.name: canLoadMorePosts
methods.description: Placeholder for loading more posts; currently resolves immediately.

methods.name: initScrollToIndex
methods.description: Determines initial scroll position based on highlighted or new message separator.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events, updates scroll state, and manages user scroll position.

methods.name: updateFloatingTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp display based on visible top item.

methods.name: onItemsRendered
methods.description: Updates visible indices and timestamp when items are rendered.

methods.name: getInitialPostIndex
methods.description: Calculates the starting index for the list, prioritizing highlighted or new messages.

methods.name: handleScrollToFailed
methods.description: Attempts to correct scroll position if scrolling to a specific item fails.

methods.name: scrollToItemCorrection
methods.description: Scrolls to a nearby item to correct position, with a maximum of 10 retries.

methods.name: scrollToItem
methods.description: Scrolls the list to a specific item index with position and optional offset.

methods.name: scrollToBottom
methods.description: Scrolls the list to the bottom.

methods.name: handleToastDismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the new message banner toast.

methods.name: handleToastClick
methods.description: Scrolls to new messages when toast is clicked.

methods.name: scrollToHighlightedPost
methods.description: Scrolls to a highlighted post if present.

methods.name: handleScrollStop
methods.description: Updates state when scrolling stops.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders individual post rows with appropriate styling and accessibility.

methods.name: getInnerStyles
methods.description: Returns inner styles based on timestamp configuration.

methods.name: isNewMessagesVisible
methods.description: Determines if new message separator is visible.

methods.name: renderToast
methods.description: Renders the new replies banner toast.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, including virtualized list and comment input.
